items.title: A. HTTP status
items.description: Every page in the sitemap answers 200.

items.title: A. Internal links
items.description: No internal link on any page is broken (4xx/5xx).

items.title: F. Accessibility and SEO basics
items.description: Each page has a title, exactly one H1, a lang attribute, alt text on content images, a meta description and no console errors.

items.title: E. Mobile 375 px
items.description: Each page fits a 375 px screen with no sideways scroll, and the menu button is at least 44 px.

items.title: D. Navigation and menus
items.description: The phone menu opens and closes, and the desktop navigation links resolve.

items.title: B. Visual snapshots
items.description: Desktop and phone screenshots of every page (up to 40), to look through in one gallery.

items.title: C. Content completeness
items.description: Text from each old page appears on its new page (needs a reference site and old-to-new URL pairs from redirects).

items.title: Site composite score
items.description: Average of the per-page scores (HTTP, links, mobile, accessibility/SEO). Pass at 90% or higher.
